name: night terrors
source:
Night terrors is a story detailing ambrosia harlow's experience with a recurring night terror - one focusing on ambrosia being stalked and kidnapped by a mysterious beast. 

With the advice of a friend, ambrosia has decided to admit themself to a psych ward in order to be treated for these terrors - thought by the hospital staff to be related to hallucinations instead.

Rumor has it among the patients of the psych ward that a monster - very similar to the one ambrosia has witnessed - has been spotted around the ward. another rumor, less popular, is that this monster is responsible for a select few patients going missing.

As time goes on, ambrosia notices strange things occurring while they're awake... things that make them suspect that this monster isn't just a night terror.

[From [url=https://e-goth.itch.io/night-terrors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《夜惊》讲述了安布罗西娅·哈洛遭遇反复出现的夜惊的经历，故事的重点是安布罗西娅被神秘野兽跟踪和绑架。

在朋友的建议下，安布罗西娅决定住进精神病房接受这些恐惧的治疗——医院工作人员认为这些恐惧与幻觉有关。

有传言说，精神科病房的病人在病房周围发现了一种怪物——与安布罗西亚亲眼目睹的怪物非常相似。另一个不太流行的谣言是，这个怪物是导致少数病人失踪的罪魁祸首。

随着时间的推移，安布罗西亚注意到在他们醒着的时候发生了奇怪的事情……这些事情让他们怀疑这个怪物不仅仅是夜惊。

[来自[url=https://e-goth.itch.io/night-terrors]Itch.io[/url]]
